test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question: **Select the wrongly spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is '**increament**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelled word is '**increament**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**Increment**'.
 
• It means** 'a regular increase in the amount of money that somebody is paid for his/her job'.** (वेतन में नियमित रूप से होने वाली वृद्धि; वेतन-वृद्धि)
 
 
• *Example: a salary with annual **increments**...*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **incorrect**: not right or true. (जो शुद्घ, सही या सच न हो; अशुद्घ, ग़लत)
 
• **incubate**: (of a bird) sit on (eggs) in order to keep them warm and bring them to hatching. [अंडे को सही तापमान पर रखना (ताकि वह विकसित होकर पक्षी को जन्‍म दे सके); अंडे सेना]
 
• **incorporate**: to make something a part of something else; to have something as a part. (एक वस्‍तु को दूसरी का अंश बनाना, समाविष्‍ट करना; एक वस्‍तु का दूसरी का अंश बनना, समाविष्‍ट होना)
